extracted.intended_audience: The people (voters) of the State of New York; general public interested in ratification of the U.S. Constitution
extracted.subtask_description: A series of late-18th-century Federalist essays (Hamilton, Madison, Publius) making the case for a stronger federal union over disunion, addressing dangers of state rivalry, standing armies, faction, and insurrection. The text is persuasive political commentary aimed at influencing public opinion on constitutional ratification.
